projects.title: Featured Projects
projects.subtitle: Systems engineered with an emphasis on architectural resilience, scientific data visualization, and performance optimization.

aetherscope.title: AetherScope / FlareField
aetherscope.subtitle: Astronomical Visualization Platform & Real-Time Space Weather Alert System
aetherscope.description: Interactive platform designed for researchers, drone operators, and space enthusiasts for visual exploration of stellar catalogs and real-time monitoring of geomagnetic storms consuming live NASA (DONKI) and NOAA APIs.
highlights: High-performance geospatial & celestial rendering using MapLibre GL and Canvas for smooth celestial coordinate plotting.
Structured caching layer reducing latency on continuous external solar and geomagnetic telemetry ingestion.
AI-accelerated development workflow with strict TypeScript typing ensuring fault tolerance and zero runtime surprises.

rescuesync.title: RescueSync / DSSD
rescuesync.subtitle: Distributed Emergency Management & Real-Time Resource Coordination Platform
rescuesync.description: Comprehensive distributed system designed to coordinate disaster response, managing regional risk tiers, critical resource inventories, and verification of organization credentials (NGOs, firefighters, medical teams) via business process orchestration.
highlights: Decoupled microservice architecture with Java Spring Boot and ACID transactional persistence on PostgreSQL.
BPM process orchestration powered by Bonita Engine REST API for contingency workflows and certification verification.
Concurrency control on medical supply allocation and granular Role-Based Access Control (JWT multi-tenant security).

alquilando.title: Alquilando & High-Performance Backend
alquilando.subtitle: Vehicle Fleet Management System & High-Performance Modular Services
alquilando.description: Vehicle fleet reservation and rental backend featuring an optimized relational database schema, strict temporal availability logic, and modular Python services (Flask/Django) with secure authentication and database query optimization.
highlights: Robust relational data model with composite indexes, foreign key integrity, and isolated transactions.
Strict business logic preventing reservation overlaps and facilitating dynamic fleet pricing calculation.
Docker containerization and unit test automation ensuring code auditability and rapid continuous integration.
